risk_if_not_implemented: Without Transfer Authorizations, sensitive and/or regulated data may be exfiltrated, leaked or transferred outside authorized boundaries without detection. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2). No threat is rated Likely for this control; threats rated Possible include Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Access Enforcement
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to enforce Logical Access Control (LAC) permissions that conform to the principle of "least privilege."
compensating_control_1.justification: Access Enforcement (IAC-25) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Transfer Authorizations (DCH-26) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Encrypting Data In Transit
compensating_control_2.description: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to prevent the unauthorized disclosure of data in transit.
compensating_control_2.justification: Encrypting Data In Transit (CRY-05) provides cryptographic protection that compensates for the absence of Transfer Authorizations (DCH-26) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative technical means. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
